categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Tongda Island New Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather. Its main products include ultra-fiber suede leather, ultra-fiber glossy leather, and ultra-fiber base fabric, which are widely used in footwear materials, sofas, electronics, sports equipment, automotive interiors, bags, and apparel. The company operates mainly in the artificial leather industry segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather technologies, including PA6/PE blended sea-island method for ultra-fine fibers and eco-friendly water-based polyurethane processes. It emphasizes environmentally friendly production methods, such as zero organic solvent usage and bio-based raw materials to reduce carbon footprint. The company holds multiple patents and certifications, and has developed proprietary technologies for high-performance protective labor ultra-fiber materials, low-carbon footprint bio-based ultra-fiber leather, and water-based polyurethane eco ultra-fiber leather.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse customer base across industries including footwear, gloves, bags, apparel, home furnishings, automotive interiors, and sports goods. Key customers include well-known domestic and international brands such as LV, CLARKS, UA, ZARA, ECCO, COLOMBO, SHIMANO, Belle, Anta, 361°, Aokang, Red Dragonfly, Kubota Slugger, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Volkswagen, Hyundai, Geely, and Aiways. The products cater to mid-to-high-end market segments globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in East China and South China regions, accounting for a large portion of revenue. It also has substantial export markets in Europe, the Americas, and Southeast Asia, with overseas sales representing nearly 40% of total revenue. The headquarters and main production facilities are located in Changyi City, Shandong Province, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shandong Tongda Island New Material Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the synthetic leather supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and development of ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather materials. It sources raw materials such as polyurethane and nylon and supplies finished synthetic leather products to downstream manufacturers and brand customers in footwear, apparel, automotive, and other industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on eco-friendly materials, high-performance protective ultra-fiber materials, water-based polyurethane processes, and product differentiation through surface effects and functional enhancements. It aims to expand its product portfolio with new applications such as lightweight sports leather, child safety protective leather, and anti-fouling outdoor sports leather. Talent development and strengthening the technical team are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather products to customers, including both direct sales and distribution channels. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, signing annual framework agreements with regional customers to plan production and budgets, followed by order-based manufacturing and sales. It also receives government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather producers in China and holds a leading position domestically with recognized brand influence internationally. It competes in the mid-to-high-end synthetic leather market, distinguished by its technological leadership, quality certifications, and eco-friendly product offerings. The report does not specify direct competitors but highlights the company's strong market share and technological advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 373.4 million, a 13.41% increase from 2023, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 8.4 million, recovering from a loss in 2023. The company’s total assets were about RMB 683.4 million with net assets of RMB 626.5 million. The company has shown steady revenue growth and improved profitability, supported by increased production volume and expanded sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, stable performance, and environmentally friendly ultra-fine fiber synthetic leather products that closely mimic natural leather in texture and appearance while offering superior durability, breathability, and eco-friendliness. Its products are certified by multiple international standards and have won numerous awards for innovation and green design. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, diversified product lines, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive customer service, aiming to meet diverse and high-end market demands.
